protocols.name: AUTHORITY_RESTORE
protocols.law: Read controlling authority; capture interruption as observation; qualify evidence separately; partition by persisted source.

protocols.name: FRONTIER_AND_FALSE_RESUME
protocols.law: Resolve latest frontier; reject already-closed work; firewall chat claims; compare GitHub/Drive without silent normalization.

protocols.name: CONCURRENCY_AND_PERSISTENCE
protocols.law: Fresh-main before write; detect drift; salvage semantic deltas; cross-store closure is transactional.

protocols.name: IDENTITY_REGISTRY_EVIDENCE
protocols.law: Fingerprint source tuple; reserve IDs only after dedupe; keep evidence classes non-substitutable.

protocols.name: READBACK_REPAIR_SIDE_EFFECTS
protocols.law: Readback defines success; repair partial writes; quarantine irreversible ambiguity; retry reversible actions only after store verification.

protocols.name: ROUTING_AND_GOVERNANCE
protocols.law: Route by information value; WIP bounded; Founder focus can authorize bounded meta-work; incident lifecycle is explicit.

protocols.name: PROMOTION_AND_SOURCE_ADEQUACY
protocols.law: Do not inflate SI-0014 counts; apply SI-0015 freshness; insufficient sources do not become invented defects; v3 evidence remains scoped.

protocols.name: TELEMETRY_TRIBUNAL_CLOSURE
protocols.law: Null-safe telemetry; promotion tribunal; library completeness; bounded closure returns control to the highest-information real gate.

global_contract_invariants: no authority from chat/model claim alone
unknown is null/HOLD, never fabricated zero/PASS
material write requires readback before closure
